$description: Fills that are their own boundary, measured against what they sit on or beside, with klar deltaE in both modes by npm run audit:contrast. A contrast floor never compares fill with fill, which is how a hover the colour of a card (deltaE 0) passed every check. Each pair must reach minDeltaE, which defaults to floor and may only be raised.

outOfScope.elevation layers: card, modal, menu and popover surfaces are deliberately deltaE 2 to 6 from what they sit on; their shadows carry them.
outOfScope.state to state: hover against rest and pressed against hover are transient feedback that the change itself and the cursor carry.
outOfScope.intent surfaces: --color-bg-forward and --color-bg-recede rank by temperature as a tertiary affordance, deliberately subtle.

separations.note: A tooltip floats with no border; its fill is its only edge. Held to 10 rather than the floor, decided by eye at the tooltip stop of the dark-mode walk-through.
